author: RIM team
description: Lists the open pull requests of public GitHub repositories you choose. Talks only to GitHub, without a token.

commands.title: Pull requests: Refresh
commands.description: Fetches the open pull requests again.

commands.title: Pull requests: Add repository
commands.description: Adds a public GitHub repository to the list, at most 10.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.description: The repository as owner/name, such as rust-lang/rust.

commands.title: Pull requests: Remove repository
commands.description: Removes a repository from the list.

panels.title: Pull requests
panels.description: Open pull requests of the repositories you added.
